exposure: Sars-CoV-2 infection status (via nasopharyngeal swab screening)
cohort: The study included 240 pregnant women attending Guglielmo da Saliceto Hospital in Piacenza, Italy, from April 22nd to June 18th, 2020.
finding: Of 240 pregnant women screened upon admission, 5% tested positive for Sars-CoV-2, all of whom were asymptomatic and did not develop COVID-19 symptoms or adverse perinatal outcomes.
followup_time: Observation for development of COVID-19 symptoms and adverse perinatal outcomes (specific duration not mentioned beyond 'perinatal outcomes')
cross-section timing: Upon admission to the hospital, between April 22nd and June 18th, 2020
